# O'Reilly Media

> O'Reilly Media is a comprehensive technology learning platform offering courses, certifications, hands-on labs, and expert-led training for individuals, teams, enterprises, and government agencies.

O'Reilly provides 5,000+ live and on-demand courses covering 30+ tech roles including Python, Kubernetes, AI, cloud computing, and enterprise security. The platform combines interactive labs, skill verification, certifications, and AI-powered support to help professionals and organizations upskill in emerging technologies.
